## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the problem and what this change makes possible or fixes.

## Changes

List the main changes and any tradeoffs a reviewer should understand.

## Validation

Describe the checks you ran and their results. Include device / Android version for UI or notification changes, and screenshots when useful. State any checks you could not run.

## Related issue

Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and a descriptive title.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Validation is reported accurately.
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, personal data, or local backend configuration are included.
